overview: Loop invariant, pre/post conditions, division by repeated subtraction, exponentiation, digit reversal.
coreConcept: Invariant = loop ke har iteration ke start me true condition.
hinglishExplanation: Loop ke baad invariant + termination condition se postcondition milti hai. e.g., division: x = q*y + r with r >= 0 invariant; exp by squaring: X^Y = res * a^b.
formalDefinition: Invariant = loop ke har iteration ke start me true condition.
commonPitfalls: Invariant post-loop guard ke saath combine bhoolna.
